agota-fatura.summary: Reads incoming invoices and receipts from a photo, PDF or email; creates the entry, matches the account and separates out the VAT.
agota-fatura.manual: Keying in invoices and receipts one by one, finding the right account and calculating VAT separately.
features: Invoice capture from photos, PDFs and email
Automatic matching to account and stock cards
Line-by-line split of VAT rate and tax base
Uncertain fields sent to you for approval
agota-fatura.audience: SMEs and accounting teams processing hundreds of purchase invoices a month.

agota-banka.summary: Pulls in bank transactions, matches them to invoices and closes open items; asks you about any transaction it can't match.
agota-banka.manual: Downloading the bank statement and matching each line to the right invoice and account by hand.
features: Smart matching by amount, description and date
A question list for unmatched transactions
agota-banka.audience: Businesses with several bank accounts and a high daily volume of collections and payments.

agota-tahsilat.summary: Sends customers WhatsApp and email reminders for receivables coming due, tracks payment promises and builds a risk score for each customer.
agota-tahsilat.manual: Calling overdue customers one by one and writing their payment promises down in a notebook.
features: Escalating reminders via WhatsApp and email
Customer risk score based on payment behavior
agota-tahsilat.audience: Wholesalers, distributors and service businesses that sell on credit terms.

agota-mutabakat.summary: Sends balance confirmation emails to your customers and suppliers, reads the replies, finds the differences and shows you only the discrepancies.
agota-mutabakat.manual: Sending a reconciliation letter to every account at period end, then collecting the replies and comparing balances one by one.
features: Pinpoints balance differences document by document
A worklist made up of discrepancies only
agota-mutabakat.audience: Companies that work with many customer and supplier accounts and reconcile balances at period end.

agota-nakit.summary: Builds a 13-week cash flow forecast from your receivables, payables, cheques and recurring expenses, and answers the question "can we cover payroll this month?"
agota-nakit.manual: Estimating the cash position in Excel spreadsheets and updating them all over again every week.
features: Automatic projection from collection and payment due dates
Early warning before a cash shortfall
Scenario comparison: what if collections are late?
agota-nakit.audience: Business owners and finance managers responsible for cash planning.

agota-cek.summary: Tracks your cheque and promissory note portfolio, maturity calendar and endorsement chain, and warns you in advance about the risk of a bounced cheque.
agota-cek.manual: Keeping cheques and notes in a ledger or Excel and chasing due dates on a calendar.
features: Portfolio of received and issued cheques and notes
agota-cek.audience: Wholesale, construction and industrial businesses that trade with cheques and promissory notes.

agota-masraf.summary: Employees take a photo of the receipt; the expense form fills itself in and goes into the approval flow.
agota-masraf.manual: Collecting receipts, filling in the expense form by hand at month end and circulating it for signatures.
features: Reads amount, date and VAT from the photo
agota-masraf.audience: Companies whose teams incur expenses in the field or while traveling.

agota-beyan.summary: At month end, gathers the documents your accountant needs, chases what's missing and keeps track of the tax filing calendar. It works alongside your accountant, not in place of them.
agota-beyan.manual: Pulling month-end documents out of folders and following up on the accountant's list of missing items by phone.
agota-beyan.audience: SMEs and sole proprietorships that work with an external accountant.

agota-liste.summary: Turns a photo and a few words into a title, description, attribute set, category and SEO copy, then adapts the listing to each marketplace's format.
agota-liste.manual: Writing titles, descriptions and attributes separately for each marketplace and mapping categories by hand.
agota-liste.audience: E-commerce sellers with large catalogs selling across multiple channels.

agota-fiyat.summary: Updates prices dynamically based on competitor prices, stock age and your target margin, and tracks your Buy Box status.
agota-fiyat.manual: Checking competitor prices one by one and changing your own prices by hand.
features: Target margin and floor price rules
Competitor price and Buy Box tracking
agota-fiyat.audience: Marketplace sellers in categories where price decides the sale.

agota-stoksenk.summary: Keeps stock in sync across all your sales channels; closes the listing when a product sells out and suggests promotions for excess stock.
agota-stoksenk.manual: Manually deducting stock on other channels when an item sells on one, and dealing with overselling.
features: Promotion suggestions for excess and aging stock
agota-stoksenk.audience: Businesses selling the same stock on several marketplaces and on their own website.

agota-yorum.summary: Answers customer questions, reviews and return requests within your target response time (SLA), and analyzes the root causes of negative reviews.
agota-yorum.manual: Jumping between seller panels to answer questions one by one, and missing response deadlines.
features: Questions from every channel on one screen
Reply drafts based on product information
agota-yorum.audience: Marketplace stores that receive dozens of customer questions a day.

agota-reklam.summary: Allocates your marketplace, Meta and Google ad budget according to product profitability and stops loss-making campaigns.
agota-reklam.manual: Downloading reports from ad dashboards and working out in Excel which campaigns actually turn a profit.
features: Suggestions to shift budget to profitable products
agota-reklam.audience: Sellers with a regular budget for marketplace and social media advertising.

agota-iade.summary: Detects damage from photos of returned items, recommends a return decision, and prepares the shipping label and refund record.
agota-iade.manual: Inspecting and deciding on each return individually, then creating the label and return record in separate systems.
features: Damage and defect detection from photos
Decision suggestions based on your return policy
Reports by return reason and product
agota-iade.audience: E-commerce businesses selling in categories with high return rates.

agota-kargo.summary: Picks the best carrier by volumetric weight, price and speed, prints labels in bulk and lets customers know about delayed deliveries on its own.
agota-kargo.manual: Choosing a carrier for every shipment, printing labels one at a time and keeping track of delays.
features: Carrier selection by volumetric weight, price and speed
agota-kargo.audience: E-commerce businesses shipping dozens of parcels a day.

agota-rakip.summary: Follows your competitors' price, stock and review activity, and sends you a weekly summary in audio and text.
agota-rakip.manual: Visiting competitor stores one by one every day and taking notes.
features: Watchlist of competitor products and stores
agota-rakip.audience: Brands and sellers who want to monitor market share in competitive categories.

agota-katalog.summary: Turns a supplier's Excel or PDF price list into product cards and marketplace listings.
agota-katalog.manual: Copying supplier lists into product cards line by line, then updating every one of them when prices change.
features: Reads Excel and PDF price lists
Drafts of new product cards and listings
agota-katalog.audience: Retail and e-commerce businesses with many suppliers and a frequently changing catalog.

agota-teklif.summary: From a WhatsApp message like "5 tons of X, price?", checks your price list, costs and stock, prepares a quote PDF and sends it to you for approval.
agota-teklif.manual: Checking the price list, costs and stock for every price inquiry and building the quote in Word from scratch.
features: Extracts products and quantities from messages
Price list, cost and stock checks
Quote PDFs in your corporate branding
agota-teklif.audience: Manufacturers and wholesalers that receive price requests via WhatsApp and email.

agota-siparis.summary: Turns orders arriving by email, WhatsApp, Excel or voice message into structured orders, and checks stock and payment terms.
agota-siparis.manual: Entering orders from different channels into the system one by one, then checking stock and credit limits separately.
features: Orders from email, WhatsApp, Excel and voice recordings
Stock, price, payment term and credit risk checks
Order recorded in the ERP once approved
agota-siparis.audience: Companies that receive orders from dealers and customers through scattered channels.

agota-musteri.summary: Updates your CRM on its own from messages, call notes and emails; reminds you of forgotten opportunities and customers who have gone quiet.
agota-musteri.manual: Forgetting to log meeting notes in the CRM and losing track of customers who needed a follow-up.
features: Automatic customer records from messages and emails
agota-musteri.audience: B2B businesses whose sales teams struggle to keep the CRM up to date.

agota-bayi.summary: Your dealers see their statements and orders in their own portal; the assistant suggests orders to each dealer based on their history.
agota-bayi.manual: Answering dealers' questions about statements and order status by phone, one call at a time.
features: Promotions and price lists per dealer
agota-bayi.audience: Manufacturers and distributors that sell through a dealer network.

agota-plasiyer.summary: A voice assistant for field sales teams: instant answers to "What's this customer's balance, and what was their last order?", plus a daily route and collection list.
agota-plasiyer.manual: Field reps calling head office and waiting for balance and order information.
features: Customer balance and history by voice query
Orders and collections recorded in the field
agota-plasiyer.audience: Distribution companies that work with field sales reps.

agota-satinal.summary: When stock drops to its minimum level, gathers prices from suppliers, compares the quotes and drafts a purchase order.
agota-satinal.manual: Calling suppliers one by one for prices whenever stock runs low and building a comparison table.
features: Comparison of price, payment terms and lead time
agota-satinal.audience: Manufacturing and trading companies that buy materials and products on a regular basis.

agota-tedarikci.summary: Scores your suppliers on delays, quality and price deviation, and shows you with data which ones to keep working with.
agota-tedarikci.manual: Judging supplier performance from memory and hearsay.
agota-tedarikci.audience: Purchasing teams that work with many suppliers.

agota-ihale.summary: Scans EKAP (Turkey's public procurement platform) and private tender notices, recommends the ones that fit your business and drafts the bid file.
agota-ihale.manual: Going through tender notices by hand every day and preparing each bid file from scratch.
agota-ihale.audience: Companies that bid in public and private sector tenders.

agota-maliyet.summary: Calculates product cost from raw materials, labor and overhead; when an input price changes, it updates the cost and the suggested selling price.
agota-maliyet.manual: Recalculating cost sheets in Excel after every price increase.
features: Allocation of raw materials, labor and overhead
Costing based on bills of materials
Automatic updates when input prices change
Selling price suggestions by target margin

agota-depo.summary: Counts stock with a phone camera, recognizes products without barcodes from their image and suggests shelf placement.
agota-depo.manual: Writing counts on paper and entering them into the system later, and looking up products without barcodes by hand.
features: Image recognition for products without barcodes
agota-depo.audience: Businesses that run regular stock counts in warehouses and stores.

agota-talep.summary: Forecasts demand from past sales and seasonality, and produces a list of how much of each product to buy.
agota-talep.manual: Estimating order quantities from experience and last year's figures.
features: Demand forecasting that accounts for seasonality
agota-talep.audience: Retail and wholesale businesses that sell seasonal products.

agota-sevk.summary: Plans vehicle routes and automates delivery notes; sends drivers their route via WhatsApp and collects delivery photos.
agota-sevk.manual: Planning routes by hand, issuing delivery notes one by one and confirming deliveries by phone.
features: Routes sent to drivers via WhatsApp
agota-sevk.audience: Wholesalers and manufacturers that deliver with their own vehicles.

agota-uretim.summary: Creates work orders and a production plan from sales orders, and answers "when will this order be ready?" based on the bill of materials (BOM) and capacity.
agota-uretim.manual: Keeping the production plan on a whiteboard or in Excel, and guessing when customers ask about delivery dates.
features: Automatic work orders from sales orders
Delivery date estimates and delay alerts
agota-uretim.audience: Small and mid-sized manufacturers that produce to order.

agota-fason.summary: Tracks subcontractor workshops in industries such as textiles and metalworking; receives stage updates via WhatsApp and calculates the profitability of subcontracted work.
agota-fason.manual: Phoning subcontractor workshops to ask what stage each job is at.
features: Tracking of jobs and materials sent to subcontractors
agota-fason.audience: Textile, metal and furniture companies that rely on subcontracted production.

agota-kalite.summary: Identifies the defect class from a photo of a faulty product and automatically prepares the non-conformance report for the supplier.
agota-kalite.manual: Recording defects on paper forms and preparing supplier reports by hand.
features: Defect statistics by supplier and batch
agota-kalite.audience: Manufacturers that carry out quality control.

agota-bakim.summary: Manages the machine maintenance schedule, lets staff report breakdowns by voice and calculates the cost of downtime.
agota-bakim.manual: Keeping maintenance dates in a notebook, reporting breakdowns verbally and never recording downtime.
agota-bakim.audience: Production facilities running a large number of machines.

agota-bordro.summary: Prepares a payroll draft from timesheets, keeps track of leave balances and reminds you of SGK (Turkish social security) deadlines. Payroll is finalized once your accountant approves it.
agota-bordro.manual: Compiling timesheets in Excel to send to the accountant and calculating leave balances by hand.
agota-bordro.audience: SMEs that prepare payroll together with an external accountant.

agota-aday.summary: Writes the job posting, screens CVs, runs initial interviews with candidates over WhatsApp and sets up the interview schedule.
agota-aday.manual: Reading hundreds of CVs one by one and arranging interviews with candidates by phone.
agota-aday.audience: Retail, manufacturing and service businesses that hire frequently.

agota-vardiya.summary: Builds the shift plan, resolves leave conflicts and calculates overtime.
agota-vardiya.manual: Drawing up the shift roster by hand every week and announcing changes in the group chat.
agota-vardiya.audience: Factories, stores, restaurants and healthcare businesses that work in shifts.

agota-rehber.summary: An internal assistant that answers questions like "How do I request leave, and who approves it?" from your company rules, helping new hires get up to speed faster.
agota-rehber.manual: Explaining the same things over and over to every new employee.
features: Knowledge base of rules and procedures
agota-rehber.audience: Growing teams that hire new people often.

agota-hat.summary: Brings WhatsApp, Instagram and email into one inbox; sends the first reply, classifies each message, assigns it to the right person and gives order and shipping status on its own.
agota-hat.manual: Keeping up with messages across several apps and answering the same questions again and again.
agota-hat.audience: Businesses that receive customer messages through more than one channel.

agota-ses.summary: A voice assistant that answers incoming calls: it takes appointments, orders and addresses, and writes a summary of every call.
agota-ses.manual: Not keeping up with the phone, failing to return missed calls and taking no notes on conversations.
features: Answers calls, even outside business hours
Transfers to the right person when needed
agota-ses.audience: Businesses that take orders and appointments by phone.

agota-sikayet.summary: Brings together reviews from complaint sites, Google and marketplaces in one place, responds to them and reports on root causes.
agota-sikayet.manual: Following complaints on different sites one by one and responding late.
features: All complaint and review sources in one list
agota-sikayet.audience: Brands and businesses whose online reputation directly affects sales.

agota-sadakat.summary: Segments your customers, sets up win-back campaigns and automatically reaches out to customers who are starting to drift away.
agota-sadakat.manual: Not noticing customers who haven't bought anything in a long time.
agota-sadakat.audience: Retail, e-commerce and service businesses that grow through repeat customers.

agota-studyo.summary: Creates social media posts, Reels scripts and product feeds from your product photos, and fills your weekly content calendar automatically.
agota-studyo.manual: Figuring out what to post every week and creating visuals and copy from scratch.
agota-studyo.audience: Brands that want to post content on social media regularly.

agota-site.summary: When you add a product to the ERP, a product page is created on your website and its SEO copy is written.
agota-site.manual: Creating a separate page on the website and writing a description for every new product.
features: Product pages in sync with the ERP
agota-site.audience: Businesses that also showcase their product catalog on their website.

agota-kampanya.summary: Prepares email, SMS and WhatsApp campaigns complete with segment, copy and timing, and produces a results report.
agota-kampanya.manual: Building campaign lists by hand, with no way to measure the results.
features: Copy suggestions suited to each channel
agota-kampanya.audience: Businesses that send regular campaigns to their customer lists.

agota-harita.summary: Manages your Google Business Profile: replies to reviews and keeps your opening hours and photos up to date.
agota-harita.manual: Leaving Google reviews unanswered and forgetting to update holiday hours.
agota-harita.audience: Stores, restaurants and clinics that serve local customers.

agota-sozlesme.summary: Reads contracts, flags risky clauses, prepares new contracts from templates and reminds you of renewal dates. It doesn't replace legal counsel; it speeds up their work.
agota-sozlesme.manual: Reading contracts line by line and missing renewal dates.
agota-sozlesme.audience: Businesses that handle many supplier, customer and lease contracts.

agota-kvkk.summary: Maps your personal data inventory, drafts privacy notices, reminds you of your VERBİS (Turkey's data controller registry) obligations and drafts replies to data subject requests.
agota-kvkk.manual: Tracking KVKK (Turkish personal data law) obligations across scattered files.
features: Reply drafts for data subject requests
agota-kvkk.audience: Any business that processes customer and employee data.

agota-arsiv.summary: Makes all your documents searchable: just say "find last year's lease agreement".
agota-arsiv.manual: Hunting for documents in folders and email inboxes.
agota-arsiv.audience: Businesses whose paper and digital documents are scattered.

agota-onay.summary: Brings expense, leave and discount approvals into a single flow; the assistant prepares the request and the approver signs off with one click.
agota-onay.manual: Wrestling with email chains and phone calls to get approvals.
agota-onay.audience: Teams with more than one level of approval.

agota-dilekce.summary: Prepares drafts of correspondence, petitions and applications to government agencies.
agota-dilekce.manual: Looking up the right format for every official letter and writing the text from scratch.
agota-dilekce.audience: Businesses that correspond frequently with government agencies.

agota-sor.summary: Ask "What were our 10 most profitable products this month?" and it writes the query itself, then answers with a table and chart.
agota-sor.manual: Opening a request with IT for a report, or building a pivot table in Excel.
agota-sor.audience: Managers who don't want to depend on someone else for reports.

agota-panel.summary: Sends the business owner a weekly summary in audio and text; the summary can also be read on WhatsApp.
agota-panel.manual: Opening separate reports one by one to find out how the week went.
agota-panel.audience: Business owners who want to take the pulse of their business in minutes.

agota-uyari.summary: Catches anomalies: "Customer X's orders are down 40%", "stock runs out in 3 days", "this supplier is late for the 3rd time".
agota-uyari.manual: Noticing problems only after the damage is done.
agota-uyari.audience: Managers who want to catch problems early.

agota-senaryo.summary: Calculates scenarios such as "What happens to profit and units sold if I raise prices by 5%?" using your own data.
agota-senaryo.manual: Modeling price and cost scenarios by hand in Excel.
features: Demand elasticity estimates from historical data
agota-senaryo.audience: Managers who make pricing and budget decisions.

agota-saha.summary: Assigns jobs to technicians and tracks their location; once a job is closed with photos, it creates the service form and invoice automatically.
agota-saha.manual: Filling in service forms on paper and turning them into invoices back at the office.
agota-saha.audience: Technical service, maintenance and installation teams.

agota-kesif.summary: Prepares quotes from the photos and voice notes taken on a site survey: air conditioning, renovation, furniture, glass balcony systems.
agota-kesif.manual: Writing up survey notes neatly back at the office and sending the quote days later.
features: Site surveys with photos and voice notes
agota-kesif.audience: Air conditioning, renovation, furniture and glass balcony companies.

agota-mutfak.summary: Calculates recipe costs, tracks waste and prepares the daily order list for your suppliers.
agota-mutfak.manual: Keeping recipe costs in Excel and placing daily ingredient orders by guesswork.

agota-randevu.summary: Turns WhatsApp and Instagram messages into appointments for businesses such as hair salons, clinics, vets and car washes.
agota-randevu.manual: Entering appointment requests that arrive by message into the calendar by hand.
features: Calendar by staff member and service
agota-randevu.audience: Service businesses that work by appointment.

agota-klinik.summary: Manages patient records, treatment plans, appointment reminders and insurance paperwork in one place.
agota-klinik.manual: Keeping patient information in scattered files and forgetting to remind patients about follow-up visits.
agota-klinik.audience: Dental, aesthetic and physiotherapy clinics, and private outpatient clinics.

agota-konak.summary: Keeps availability in sync across channels such as Booking.com and Airbnb for hotels and guesthouses, answers guests through a WhatsApp assistant and speeds up check-in.
agota-konak.manual: Updating availability by hand on every channel and answering guest questions one by one.
agota-konak.audience: Boutique hotels, guesthouses and apartment rentals.

agota-servis.summary: In the auto repair shop, pulls up a vehicle's history from its license plate, opens work orders by voice, orders parts and sends customers status messages.
agota-servis.manual: Writing work orders on paper and phoning customers to update them on their vehicle.
features: Vehicle and service history by license plate
agota-servis.audience: Auto repair, tire and body shops.

agota-emlak.summary: Writes listing copy, matches your portfolio with buyer requests and schedules viewings.
agota-emlak.manual: Keeping buyer requests in your head and searching the portfolio for a match by hand.
agota-emlak.audience: Real estate agencies and property consultants.

agota-santiye.summary: Tracks progress payments, quantity take-offs and timesheets on the construction site, and takes material requests via WhatsApp.
agota-santiye.manual: Managing progress payments and timesheets in Excel and material requests by phone.

agota-tarla.summary: Calculates production costs on farms and in greenhouses, tracks wholesale produce market prices, and keeps spraying and irrigation records.
agota-tarla.manual: Writing field expenses and treatments down in a notebook.
agota-tarla.audience: Farmers, greenhouse operations and producer associations.

agota-kurs.summary: Manages enrollment, installments, attendance and updates to parents and members for courses, tutoring centers and gyms.
agota-kurs.manual: Keeping enrollments and installments in a ledger and messaging parents one by one.
features: Update messages for parents and members
agota-kurs.audience: Courses, tutoring centers, gyms and dance studios.

agota-musavir.summary: Helps accounting offices collect documents from their clients, chase missing items and manage the tax filing calendar.
agota-musavir.manual: Calling dozens of clients every month to ask for their documents.
agota-musavir.audience: Certified public accountants (mali müşavir) and accounting offices.

agota-atolye.summary: Manages style and sample tracking, cutting plans, subcontracting, and yarn and fabric tracking for apparel workshops.
agota-atolye.manual: Tracking style and cutting details on paper spec sheets.

agota-filo.summary: Matches vehicles, drivers and loads for freight companies, and keeps track of fuel and traffic fines.
agota-filo.manual: Matching loads by phone and tracking fuel and fines in Excel.
features: Tracking of fines and document expiry dates

agota-market.summary: Point of sale (POS), expiry date tracking and automatic supplier orders for grocery and corner stores.
agota-market.manual: Checking shelf by shelf for products nearing their expiry date and placing orders by eye.
agota-market.audience: Grocery stores, corner shops and delis.

agota-store.summary: An app and assistant marketplace for Agota: third-party developers build assistants and publish them under a revenue-sharing model.
agota-store.manual: Searching for and integrating separate software for every feature you need.

agota-tedarik.summary: A B2B marketplace for businesses that use Agota: products in stock are listed automatically, and the buyer's purchasing assistant gets quotes from the seller's sales assistant.
agota-tedarik.manual: Gathering quotes by phone and email to find suppliers.
features: Orders recorded automatically in the ERP

agota-fasonpazar.summary: Matches idle production capacity with work: finds the right workshop for a request like "sewing 1,000 T-shirts in 2 weeks".
agota-fasonpazar.manual: Asking around your network to find a subcontract workshop.

agota-hizmet.summary: Collects and compares quotes for business services such as transport, cleaning, renovation and security.
agota-hizmet.manual: Calling a different set of companies for each service and asking each for a quote.
agota-hizmet.audience: Businesses that purchase services on a regular basis.

agota-makine.summary: A marketplace for used machinery and equipment: put items up for sale straight from the fixed-asset list in your ERP with one click.
agota-makine.manual: Listing unused machines one by one on classifieds sites.
agota-makine.audience: Manufacturers that are renewing their equipment.

agota-endeks.summary: Produces industry indices for prices, margins and collection times from anonymized data, and benchmarks your business against the industry average.
agota-endeks.manual: Knowing industry averages only through guesswork or hearsay.
agota-endeks.audience: Businesses that want to back their decisions with industry data.

agota-finans.summary: Based on your invoice, collection and cash data, helps you evaluate factoring and business loan options and prepare your application file.
agota-finans.manual: Preparing documents separately for each bank and factoring company and applying to each one individually.
agota-finans.audience: SMEs looking for financing to grow or to meet cash needs.
